meta.name: liger-kernel-perf
meta.description: Optimizes the performance of existing Liger Kernel Triton kernels. Profiles kernels, diagnoses bottlenecks (memory-bound vs compute-bound), generates multiple optimization variants with benchmarking, and applies the best variant while maintaining correctness. Supports GPU architecture-specific optimization (Ampere, Hopper, Blackwell). Use when a user asks to optimize, speed up, tune, profile, or reduce memory of an existing Liger kernel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动剖析并优化 Triton 内核，突破 GPU 性能瓶颈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Triton 编写 GPU 内核并想榨干硬件性能。
copy.tagline_en: Profile and optimize Triton kernels automatically to boost GPU performance.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write Triton kernels and want to maximize hardware utilization.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude会分析指定的Liger内核，运行基准测试，诊断是内存限制还是计算限制，生成多个优化变体并测试，选出最佳变体应用到原代码，最后生成报告和对比图。
howto.when: 当用户要求优化、加速、调优或减少现有Liger内核的内存使用时触发。必须指定内核名称（如rms_norm）。

say.note: 仅运行Profile阶段并给出诊断。

say.text: 以自主模式优化，不用问我。
say.note: 所有阶段自动运行，只输出最终报告。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will analyze the specified Liger kernel, run baseline benchmarks, diagnose bottlenecks (memory-bound vs compute-bound), generate multiple optimization variants with benchmarking, select the best variant, apply it in-place, and produce a final report with comparison plots.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user asks to optimize, speed up, tune, profile, or reduce memory of an existing Liger kernel. Requires specifying the kernel name (e.g., rms_norm).

say_en.text: Optimize the speed of the rms_norm kernel.
say_en.note: Claude will run the full Profile→Optimize→Finalize pipeline.

say_en.text: Profile the cross_entropy kernel for bottlenecks.
say_en.note: Runs only the Profile stage and outputs diagnosis.
All stages run end-to-end, only final report shown.
